subject: Renewal + capacity increase: procurement intake and onboarding steps
messages:
From: Caroline Hart <caroline.hart@arbor-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@arbor-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and capacity increase — procurement intake for Q4 expansion

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — Arbor is excited to move ahead with a renewal + capacity increase for our Q4 rollout. Two quick things the procurement team asked me to confirm before we start the PO:

- Can Redwood accept a 24-month term with a scheduled capacity ramp (25% more GPU vCPU-equivalent after month 6, another 25% after month 12)?
- Procurement needs the vendor onboarding packet (W-9, SOC2 evidence, insurance) uploaded to their portal and a completed onboarding checklist. They mentioned the portal ticketing reference number will be required for the PO.

I attached a draft SOW (v1) to this message for scope and tiers. Can your team confirm timeline for the onboarding upload and whether the proposed term is OK? Once procurement has the portal ticket and SOW they will kick off the PO.

Thanks,
Caroline
Caroline Hart
Head of IT Procurement
Arbor Analytics
procurement@arbor-analytics.com

Attachments: Arbor_SOW_v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity increase — procurement intake for Q4 expansion

Hi Caroline — great to hear, and thanks for sending the draft SOW. We're aligned on next steps and can support the 24-month term + staged capacity increases, subject to a standard tiered-commitment amendment (pricing to be adjusted for the longer term and the staged capacity).

Action items we will handle this week:
- I will upload the vendor onboarding packet (W-9, SOC2 summary, certs, proof of insurance) into Arbor's procurement portal. Expect a ticket number once upload completes.
- Ben will finalize the commercial redlines and produce SOW v2 reflecting the staged capacity bumps and term length.
- Priyom will open an internal finance thread to verify billing cadence and any required PO language for the 24-month commitment.

I've attached our internal onboarding checklist to help Arbor's procurement team map required fields. If you can confirm who on your side will own the portal upload, that'll speed things up.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — I'll have Julia (procurement@arbor-analytics.com) upload the final vendor fields but can you confirm the following so we can map on our side: 

1) SOC2 report: do you provide the full report or a SOC2 Type II summary + control matrix? Procurement noted they prefer the full report but will accept summarized evidence if we provide a secure link.
2) PO language: we need the 24-month term spelled out with the quarterly ramp schedule and an appendix that calls out the capacity bump pricing at each tier. Is that something Ben can capture in the SOW v2?

Also — are you able to issue the initial vendor portal ticket before the final SOW? Procurement prefers a ticket showing "onboarding in progress" so they can start internal routing.

On our end, Julia will try to start the portal intake today and will include me and procurement@arbor-analytics.com on the ticket.

Caroline

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: internal: Arbor renewal — SOW redlines and pricing impact

Marissa / Priyom — quick internal note before I produce SOW v2:

- Pricing impact is primarily driven by the 24-month commitment (we can offer a term discount) and the planned ramp schedule. I estimate a net 12–16% blended discount compared to current month-to-month list rates; exact % depends on firmed capacity tiers.
- Need clarity on billing cadence (annual vs quarterly invoicing) — Priyom, can you confirm preferred defaults for Arbor? If Arbor requires quarterly billing we should model cashflow differences.
- Legal requested a vendor portal artifact: their portal requires an "onboarding ticket ID" field on the SOW cover page. Marissa — if you can start the portal upload and save the ticket id we can reference it in the SOW and accelerate procurement routing.

I'll draft SOW v2 with the appendix for staged capacity pricing and share back by EOD tomorrow.

Ben Carter
